{{Quote|Though the non-exclusivity pact of the Intergalactic Banking Clan may limit their military contributions to the Confederacy of Independent Systems cause, it has allowed the commerce entity to continue operations within Republic financial circles and bolster the value of the CIS credit.|"Confederate Credits Gaining Equity," ''CIS Shadowfeed 14:3:10 Dispatch''|<ref name="14:3:10" />}}
Sometime between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Confederacy and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] signed a '''non-exclusivity pact''' that allowed the Banking Clan to continue financial operations with the Republic and raise the value of the [[CIS credit]]. Information on the pact was reported in the "Confederate Credits Gaining Equity" article of the [[21 BBY/Legends|14:3:10]] edition of the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|''CIS Shadowfeed'']] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] program.<ref name="14:3:10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The non-exclusivity pact appeared in "[[CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:3:10 Edition]]," an article written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] as an [[in-universe]] news report in the [[Star Wars Insider 66|sixty-sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine issue,<ref name="14:3:10" /> published on [[March 4]], [[2003]].<ref name="InsiderDate">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/02/news20030203.html|text=''Star Wars Insider'' #66}}</ref>
